{"command": "python3 - <<'PY'
import socket,re,sys
sys.set_int_max_str_digits(0)
s=socket.create_connection(('172.19.0.2',21200),timeout=20)
s.settimeout(20)
data=b''
while b'>' not in data:
    chunk=s.recv(4096)
    if not chunk: raise SystemExit('closed before prompt: '+repr(data))
    data+=chunk
print(data.decode(errors='replace').rstrip())
m=re.search(rb'base (\d+)',data)
if not m: raise SystemExit('Could not parse base')
b=int(m.group(1)); print('base',b)
d=[0]*b; d[0]=b-4; d[1]=2; d[2]=1; d[b-4]=1
r=0
for x in d: r=r*b+x
text=str(r).encode()+b'\n'
print('sending decimal digits:',len(text)-1)
s.sendall(text)
response=b''
while True:
    try: chunk=s.recv(4096)
    except socket.timeout: break
    if not chunk: break
    response+=chunk
print(response.decode(errors='replace'))
s.close()
PY", "timeout_seconds": 45}
